verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only describes SSO in general terms: authenticate once with an IdP to reach connected service providers. Nothing documents configuring custom (non-catalog) SAML, OIDC, or header-based apps, or any walkthroughs for doing so. The OIDC citation is about Cross App Access for agent-to-app connections, a different capability that does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an IT admin, apps outside the catalog still get SSO — custom SAML, OIDC, and header-based apps configured with documented walkthroughs
